industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Grenergy Renovables S.A
summary: Grenergy Renovables, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an independent energy producer. It operates through Development and Construction, Energy, and Services divisions. The company designs, develops, executes, and operates renewable energy plants, including solar and wind energy plants. Its activities include promotion and commercialization of renewable energy installations; production of electric energy; and management and operation renewable energy installations. It has operations in Chile, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Argentina, and Spain. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain. Grenergy Renovables, S.A. is a subsidiary of Daruan Group Holding, S.L.
